sources.label: KPMG PAXG Redemption Assets Report - July 31, 2026
Paxos PAXG allocation and physical gold bar details

reserveReview.rationale: KPMG's unmodified examination as of July 31, 2026 at 5:00 PM Eastern Time, signed August 25, reconciles 442,217 PAXG redeemable tokens (441,939 Ethereum and 278 Solana) to 442,217 fine troy ounces of London Good Delivery gold. Exhibits A-C report no nonredeemable tokens, timing adjustments, or surplus/deficit. Exhibit B identifies allocated gold as the sole redemption asset type and names Brink's Global Services Ltd. and ICBC Standard Bank as LBMA-approved vault providers without provider-level ounce shares. The reviewed official Framer route and product modules are hash-pinned alongside the PDF to detect changes to published report selection.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: KPMG examination of PAXG redemption assets and redeemable tokens as of July 31, 2026
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The complete reserve asset type is independently examined as allocated London Good Delivery gold. The report names Brink's Global Services Ltd. and ICBC Standard Bank as the LBMA-approved vault providers but does not disclose the ounces held with each provider.
